name: @tty-pt/mm
description: Universal Node.js and Deno N-API bindings for libmm (Pure-C Two-Tier Multi-Axis Memory & Codebase Intelligence Engine)

scripts.build:native: NODE_INC=$(dirname $(dirname $(command -v node)))/include/node; mkdir -p build/Release dist && gcc -O3 -fPIC -shared -I"$NODE_INC" -I/usr/include/node -I../include -I../../libcorm/include -I../../libstele/include native/mm_napi.c -L../lib -L../../libcorm/lib -L../../libstele/lib -Wl,-rpath,'$ORIGIN:$ORIGIN/../../lib:$ORIGIN/../../../libcorm/lib:$ORIGIN/../../../libstele/lib:../lib:../../libcorm/lib:../../libstele/lib' -lmm -lcorm -lstele -lm -o build/Release/mm_node.node && cp build/Release/mm_node.node dist/mm_node.node && cp build/Release/mm_node.node dist/mm.node && (test -d prebuilds/linux-x64 && cp build/Release/mm_node.node prebuilds/linux-x64/mm.node || true)

author: Paulo Quirino <quirinpa@gmail.com>
